title: Eric's surprised and tired faces
question: Which surprised face and which tired face should Eric use?

media.caption: All 27 attempts in order, the approved neutral first. Only the face was repainted (brows to chin, inside the jaw line). Round s1/t1/t2 had frowning brows on most seeds; s2/t3 add "frown, furrowed brow, angry" to the negative, nothing else changed. Prompts and settings per attempt: log.json in the same folder.
The approved neutral they are made from (game file, 25% closer framing).
